payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether Section B(1)'s 12-month schedule establishes (a) a compliance deadline for cyanide limits already applicable from the permit effective date or (b) the date when final cyanide limits first become the governing enforceable limits for Section B(1)(a) progress reporting. The packet contains only the Section B(1) schedule language and adjacent TDS context. It omits the cyanide effluent limitations specified elsewhere, any cyanide-specific effective-date footnotes, the permit effective date itself, and any linkage to Federal FY2025 measurement and reporting periods. Without those sources, neither interpretation can be established, and the TDS parallel does not ground a cyanide-specific adjudication. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
